build: Source bundle (Rolldown); prototype transformations exist only in the benchmark. Not a minified production or live Fly measurement.
measurementNotes: Reported CPU in flight excludes startup and warmup, includes snapshots/JSON and packet hashing, excludes transport/TLS.
Memory samples report before and after forced full GC. That diagnostic collection is outside phase timing. No forced GC occurs inside measured flight ticks.
Three-observer activation is direct placement, not actual flight; GameCollisions runs with dt=0.
Initial heap512-* attempts did not forward the old-space flag and are excluded. Bounded checks assert the actual child argument and heap limit.

boundedHeapCapacityChecks.note: One spread-flight run per mode; --max-old-space-size=512 was verified in child execArgv. Actual total V8 heap limit was 560 MiB. This is not a 512 MiB total-process limit, nor a repeated CPU comparison.
